title: Install Futureverse in One Go
text: Start configuring Futureverse parallelize current computer: , takes minor tweak make existing lapply(), map(), foreach() code run parallel, e.g. get progress updates, add |> progressify(), e.g.
code: future::plan(future::multisession) library(futurize)  ## Sequential and parallel version of base R apply y <- lapply(X, slow_fcn) y <- lapply(X, slow_fcn) |> futurize()  ## Sequential and parallel version of purrr map library(purrr) y <- X |> map(slow_fcn) y <- X |> map(slow_fcn) |> futurize()  ## Sequential and parallel version of foreach library(foreach) y <- foreach(x = X) %do% slow_fcn(x) y <- foreach(x = X) %do% slow_fcn(x) |> futurize() library(progressify)  y <- lapply(X, slow_fcn) |> progressify() |> futurize() y <- X |> map(slow_fcn) |> progressify() |> futurize() y <- foreach(x = X) %do% slow_fcn(x) |> progressify() |> futurize()

title: Install Futureverse in One Go
text: Call: install: future - core Futureverse package futurize - one-stop package map-reduce parallelization progressr - Near-live progress updates using Futureverse progressify - one-stop package map-reduce progress updates support packages: future.apply - Futureverse variants base-R apply functions furrr - Futureverse variants purrr apply functions doFuture - Futureverse adaptors foreach package Call: install also additional parallel backends: future.mirai - modern alternative built-plan(multisession) future.callr - memory efficient alternative built-plan(multisession) future.batchtools - parallelize HPC job schedulers; Load Sharing Facility (LSF), OpenLava, TORQUE/PBS, Sun/Son /Oracle/Univa/Altair Grid Engine (SGE), Slurm
